title: SensorTelemetry
description: Standard edge telemetry payload generated by Solar Sentry ESP32 DevKit.

device_id.description: Unique identifier of the edge controller

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp or epoch timestamp string

uptime_seconds.description: Uptime of the ESP32 in seconds

temperature.description: Ambient temperature in Celsius from DHT22 (or BMP280 fallback)

pressure.description: Barometric atmospheric pressure in hPa from BMP280

lux.description: Ambient illuminance in Lux from BH1750

rain_raw.description: Raw 12-bit ADC reading from Rain sensor (GPIO34)

rain_detected.description: Boolean flag indicating if rain threshold is exceeded

pan.description: Current pan servo angle in degrees (GPIO18)

tilt.description: Current tilt servo angle in degrees (GPIO19)

state.description: Current system state of the edge controller

health.description: Device health score computed locally from sensor and comms validity

camera_online.description: Status of the ESP32-CAM companion node

camera_ip.description: IP address of the ESP32-CAM if known
